notes.title: Lumiland Developers Live Stream
notes.content:
Hi all,

We are taking part in the Steam Game Festival from Feb. 3rd to 9th with a free demo! As part of the event, we're holding a one-hour live stream starting at 9pm on Feb. 6th (Saturday). We will be playing our demo as we talk about this game's development process and answer questions from the chat. Stop by if you're interested in its mechanics or art style, or if you're stuck at the last level of the demo. See you then!

Lumiland Developers

[h2]About Lumiland[/h2]

Lumiland is a sokoban-like 3D puzzle game. You control two characters with different abilities to solve the puzzles. Check out our store page for more details!
